findings.text: The old code escaped every ESC (\033) as . The new code only strips complete `ESC[digits;m` sequences. Any other ESC byte is now written raw into the XML, for example `\033[K`, `\033[2J`, `\033[1A`, or a bare ESC. ESC is illegal in XML 1.0, so a test whose output contains one of these produces a JUnit file that parsers reject.
